notes: Version 1.0.230 — multi-partition .acerep reports and more accurate damaged-file detection.
changelog: New: one client .acerep report for several partitions — one .roa file per partition.
New: import file lists from R-Studio, DMDE and UFS Explorer; deleted files from R-Studio are marked yellow.
New: reuse previously generated thumbnails; Stop button for thumbnails and recovery tools.
Improved: much more accurate detection of damaged JPEG, PNG, PDF and Office files.
Fixed: WebP no longer marked as damaged; thumbnail % setting is remembered.
